test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P and Q can do a work in 12 days and 9 days, respectively. They both worked together and earned ₹63,000. The share of P (in Rs.) is:
solution:
**Given:**

P can complete the work in 12 days.

Q can complete the work in 9 days.

Total earnings for the work = ₹63,000

**Formula Used:**

Work done by P in one day = 1 / 12

Work done by Q in one day = 1 / 9

Combined work done by P and Q in one day = (1 / 12) + (1 / 9)

Share of P = (Work done by P) / (Total work)
